ns2:course.label: Seminar in Ceramics
ns2:course.description: Seminar on current research in ceramic science and engineering; includes presentations by visiting lecturers, staff, and students. May be repeated. A maximum of 2 hours of MSE 529, MSE 559, and MSE 590 may count toward the MatSE M.S. degree; likewise 4 hours for the MatSE Ph.D. degree. Approved for S/U grading only.
